summary: Backend-only testing of Cryptoffiliate FastAPI. Created pytest suite covering all 9 review scenarios. All 9 tests PASS in 12.5s. Live ticker is serving from Kraken (source=kraken) with proper 60s caching. AI Advisor SSE stream emits BOTH new {type:delta} and legacy {type:content_block_delta} events and terminates with [DONE]. Non-streaming /analyze returns a non-empty scam-detector response. Validation errors (empty messages, assistant-last, empty prompt) all return 400. Mongo status round-trip persists and reads back via UUID id without ObjectId leakage.

minor.issue: DOGE/USD silently dropped — Kraken returns the pair under key 'XDGUSD' (not 'XDOGEUSD'), so substring lookup find_row('DOGEUSD') -> looks for 'DOGE' in keys and fails. Result: 7 of 8 configured coins ship. Either map DOGEUSD->XDGUSD explicitly or also probe by altname via /0/public/AssetPairs.

action_items: (Optional) Fix DOGE/USD ticker mapping so all 8 configured coins surface. Kraken altname for Dogecoin is 'XDGUSD' or use /0/public/AssetPairs to resolve aliases.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 360 lines — fine for now, but ticker + AI advisor will outgrow this; consider splitting into routes/ai.py and routes/ticker.py once features expand.
AI_SYSTEM_PROMPT hard-codes 2026 fee data inline. Move to a JSON/YAML config so non-engineers can update fees without touching code.
_ticker_cache is a module-level dict — not concurrency-safe under multiple workers (each worker has its own cache, OK functionally but expect ~N upstream calls per minute with N workers).
AnalyzeRequest path catches generic Exception and re-raises as 502; consider catching HTTPException separately to avoid double-wrapping.

ai_advisor builds 'thread_context' inside system prompt rather than using LlmChat session reuse; works but loses true multi-turn memory across calls (every request is a fresh chat with session_id). Confirm intended.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth on these endpoints. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY present in /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Tests create one TEST_<uuid8> StatusCheck row per run (no cleanup endpoint; safe to leave).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_cryptoffiliate_api.py. Use BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. SSE test reads with requests stream=True and parses 'data:' lines; expect both delta formats + [DONE]. Ticker cache test relies on TTL=60s — second call within 1.5s should return identical updated_at.
